candidate.name: Contender
candidate.architecture: 6→64→64→3 Tanh; all 4,803 affine parameters learned; no fixed trajectory calculations or action feedback
candidate.selection_note: Selected before final testing from the same 512 fresh development seeds. Highest weaker-target ordinary-game win rate among the prior learned PPO baseline, two weight-search variants and the improved PPO continuation: 696/1024 (67.97%) against attacker and 920/1024 (89.84%) against v2. The interceptor mostly draws (164/1024 games won); this tradeoff is reported. Final test blocks are untouched at freeze.

verification_note: The selected graph exactly matches the plain trainable checkpoint: 4,803 learned parameters, zero fixed feature or feedback parameters. Native ONNX and PyTorch agree on 8,192 reachable observations. Six complete matches reproduce in the live TypeScript engine and browser WASM: 38,914 decisions, 19,481 frames, 22 loop draws and one timeout, all actions and physical states identical. Rules, validator, scripted attacker, v2 weights and standalone v1/v2/v3 packages remain unchanged.
